params.purity_proxy_score: mean z-score (across the analysed tumours) of the proxy genes present
params.site_pooling: tissue source sites with < 10 tumours pooled as 'other'; Cramer's V from the chi-squared test of cluster x site
params.ari_ceiling: maximum ARI over all partitions of the reference classes into k* = 2 blocks (exhaustive set-partition enumeration)
params.pam50_two_groups: PAM50 collapsed to luminal (LumA, LumB) vs Basal+Her2, Normal-like left out; scored on the tumours each reference labels
params.cluster_stability: for each k-means cluster, the best-match Jaccard index (|A and B| / |A or B|) with any cluster of each alternative run at the same k (Ward, average-linkage, consensus, and the gene-set sensitivity runs); Jaccard < 0.5 is commonly read as a cluster that dissolves (Hennig 2007)
params.netanely_mapping: heuristic by majority PAM50 class: basal if top class Basal with share >= 0.8; HER2-enriched if top class Her2; homogeneous LumA if top class LumA with share >= 0.75; else mixed LumA/LumB
